description: A injury that involves the vertebral column.

description: An infectious disease where a pathogen is carried and transmitted by another organism that acts as disease vector.
label: vector-borne disease

description: A viral, bacterial, fungal, or parasitic infectious process that affects the digestive system.
label: digestive system infectious disorder

description: Invasion of the host RESPIRATORY SYSTEM by microorganisms, usually leading to pathological processes or diseases.
label: respiratory tract infectious disorder

description: An infectious process affecting any part of the eye. Causes include viruses and bacteria. Symptoms include itching and discomfort in the eye, watery eyes, eye pain and discharge, and blurring vision. Representative examples include pink eye, blepharitis, and trachoma.
label: eye infectious disorder

description: Skin diseases caused by bacteria, fungi, parasites, or viruses.
label: skin disorder caused by infection
